description:
Repro (base binary):
    def both(x, y) when x and y, do: x
    def both(_, _), do: :no
    def main() do
      n = Process.heap_alloc_stats()[:allocs]
      t = n < n + 1
      f = n > n + 1
      dbg({both(t, t), both(t, f), both(f, t)})
    end
interp prints {true, :no, :no}. run fails: `JIT compile failed: codegen: verify both__e8: inst14 (v14 = call fn3(v10)): uses value v10 from non-dominating inst8`. Done when: an oracle fixture agrees on all three paths.
title: A guard `when x and y` compiles in the JIT
